verdict.rationale: Bolna's own docs state it supports 40+ languages and that the agent detects and switches language mid-call on its own. The agent configuration lets developers add multiple languages, set a default, and write a dedicated prompt for each. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how mid-call detection and switching works (triggers, provider dependencies, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that switching works in live calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run conversations in multiple languages, including detecting and switching language mid-call

citations.quote: 40+ languages including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Bengali with native accents — the agent detects and switches mid-call on its own.
